welcome: Welcome to The Carriage. It's a 1920s railway carriage that I restored and set down under the big fig. Take your time here, run a bath outside, and listen to the paddock. The TV and the phone page behind its QR code have the Wi-Fi, door code and air conditioning.

rules.title: Quiet hours
rules.body: Please keep noise down from 10pm to 7am. Sound carries across the paddock at night.

rules.title: Water is rainwater
rules.body: The tank is rainwater, so keep showers short. Fill the clawfoot bath only once per stay if you can.

rules.title: Composting toilet
rules.body: Only toilet paper goes in. Add a scoop of the sawdust after each use. Please put nothing else in, including wipes.

rules.title: Fire and candles
rules.body: No open flames inside the carriage. Use the outdoor fire area only if the host has told you it is allowed, and never on a total fire ban day.

rules.title: Smoking
rules.body: No smoking or vaping inside the carriage. Please take butts with you.

rules.title: Wildlife and paddock
rules.body: Keep food sealed and bins closed, as possums and other wildlife will visit. Please take care with the fig's roots and the paddock gate.

howto.title: Outdoor bath
howto.body: Turn the bath tap on and check the water temperature with your hand before you get in. Pull the plug when you finish. Rinse it out and wipe it dry.

howto.title: Composting toilet
howto.body: Add a scoop of sawdust after each use. Keep the lid down. If the bin looks full, tell the host.

howto.title: Wi-Fi, door code and air conditioning
howto.body: Look at the TV. It shows the Wi-Fi name and password, the door code and the air conditioning controls. Scan the QR code to see them on your phone.

howto.title: Rubbish and recycling
howto.body: Put rubbish and recycling in the bins by the gate. Please keep lids shut so animals stay out.

items.name: Bangalow Pub (Bangalow Hotel)
items.note: A classic country pub with a dining room. Book ahead for dinner.

items.name: BangBurgerBar
items.note: Easy burgers and chips when you can't face cooking.

items.name: Mangosteen
items.note: A Japanese lunch spot on a local's tip list. Good for a quiet, special lunch.

items.name: Woods
items.note: A Bangalow favourite for a long breakfast or lunch.

items.name: Minyon Falls lookout, Nightcap National Park
items.note: A big waterfall in World Heritage rainforest. Take a picnic.

items.name: Bangalow Farmers Market
items.note: Saturday mornings, behind the Bangalow Hotel. Local produce and a good wander.

items.name: Bangalow Markets
items.note: Held monthly on a Sunday. Check the date before you go.

items.name: Bangalow Bread Co.
items.note: Grab fresh bread and a coffee for the morning.

items.name: Butcher Baker
items.note: A local breakfast and coffee stop in town.

items.name: Main Beach, Byron Bay
items.note: The classic Byron beach, with cafes and shops close by.

items.name: Piccabeen Park (Bangalow Weir)
items.note: A popular picnic spot by the water.

items.name: Bangalow heritage walk
items.note: A stroll past the village's old buildings.

items.name: Heritage House Museum
items.note: A small local museum about Bangalow's past.

items.name: Bangalow Pub
items.note: Dry, warm and relaxed for a long lunch.

steps: Strip the beds and leave the linen in a pile
Wash up and put dishes away
Take your rubbish and recycling to the bins by the gate
Close all windows and turn off the lights
Pull the bath plug and wipe the bath dry
Check the TV for how to lock up, then pull the door closed
